definition.en: The Banking Ombudsman is a quasi-judicial authority created by the Reserve Bank of India to resolve customer grievances against banks in a cost-free and expeditious manner.
definition.hi: The Banking Ombudsman is a quasi-judicial authority created by the Reserve Bank of India to resolve customer grievances against banks in a cost-free and expeditious manner.

importanceInUpsc.en: Understanding the Banking Ombudsman is crucial for UPSC GS-3 as it reflects the regulatory framework ensuring consumer protection and financial inclusion in the Indian economy. It serves as a key mechanism for grievance redressal, which is a vital component of the accountability and transparency standards expected in the banking sector.
